title: Brazilian Roasted Sultana Salad
description: A sweet and savory salad made with roasted sultanas, perfect for a light meal or snack. This recipe is inspired by Brazilian cuisine and is perfect for warm weather.
instructions: Toss sultanas with 1 tablespoon of oil and roast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until caramelized.
In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, roasted red peppers, feta cheese, and pine nuts.
In a small bowl, whisk together Brazilian-style vinaigrette and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Drizzle vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
Top with roasted sultanas and serve.
